thread:
Maria: Heads-up — I'm dropping zenith-22b weights to gs://redwood-models/zenith/22b/v2. Need a quick pass on tokenizer diffs, RoPE scaling sanity, and attention fallback/impl checks before we can canary. @David @Leo @Ajay please triage.

David: Got it. I'll run the tokenizer diff today. Which tokenizer variant should I compare against?

Maria: Compare against `tok-v1` in the repo. New model uses a byte-level BPE with offset tables (see offsets.json in the bucket). Note one known quirk: control-char normalization changed (we collapse 0x0A/0x0D -> \n). Run:```python
scripts/tokenizer/diff_tokenizer.py \
  --ref artifacts/tokenizers/tok-v1.json \
  --candidate gs://redwood-models/zenith/22b/v2/tokenizer.json \
  --out /tmp/zenith-token-diff.log
``` Should be quick (~2–3m).

Leo: I'll smoke-test the attention impl. Quick question: RoPE scale is set to `1.0` in the model config, right? If it's nonstandard we need to confirm our rotary implementation aligns (mqa/gqa fractional scaling edgecases).

Maria: Config lives in infra/models/zenith/22b/config.yaml. Relevant snippet:```yaml
attention:
  type: fused_flash
  rope_scale: 1.0
  qk_split: mqa
  sliding_window: enabled
```

Ajay: FYI this model was exported with MQA layout. Runtime mapping exists but we should validate sliding-window offsets + KV cache TTL. I'll run the runtime converter and a small end-to-end with a 2k token prompt. PR #4212 contains the converter changes (ping @Ben for review).

Sarah: What's the canary plan? Prefer weekday afternoon so SRE can watch metrics. Also infra-bot will block canary if unit tests/regressions fail.

Maria: Plan: canary on 1 Dedicated host for 30m, synthetic load + A/B traffic split 5%. Target window: today 16:30–17:00 PST if tests pass.

David: Tokenizer diff found 3 mismatches (mostly control-char handling + 1 rare multi-byte boundary case). Log: gs://redwood-logs/zenith/token-diff-2938456789.log. I can patch tokenizer to preserve previous normalization if we prefer backward compatibility.

Maria: Thanks. For the multi-byte boundary case, can you paste the offending input here? If it's rare we can add a pre-tokenize cleanup.

David: Example input that mismatched: `"\u2028\u200Bend"` — zero-width + line-sep. Current candidate strips ZWSP. Quick fix: normalize ZWSP -> space before tokenization.

Carla: Small note on fallback: if RoPE scale != 1.0 we should prefer the quantized fallback model for low-capacity deployments. See runtime config `fallback_policy: prefer-quantized` — I'd add it to config to avoid surprise OOMs.

Ben: On review, will look after the standup. If Ajay's runtime convert passes the 2k test and David's tokenizer patch is tiny, we can greenlight the canary. :+1:

Maria: Added `fallback_policy: prefer-quantized` in a quick commit and pushed. Also updated the canary runbook with rollback steps.

deploy-bot: Canary queued by Maria for zenith-22b v2. Preconditions: unit-tests=pass, integration-smoke=pass.

infra-bot: Unit tests passed (zenith suite). Integration smoke queued.

deploy-bot: Canary started on host r-infer-03. Monitoring: latency p95, token throughput, kv-hit-rate. Will post metrics snapshot in 10m.

Maria: Thanks everyone — please ping on thread if you see anomalies. If no blockers by 16:20 PST we'll proceed.
